top_only.label: Charged Slot Only
top_only.description: On: only the charged slot casts (Fable 3). Off: Fable 2's cascade, each slot with its partner.

allow_same.label: Allow Same Spell
allow_same.description: A partner equal to the slot's own spell casts it twice.

cost_like.label: Priced Like Ability
cost_like.description: The ability whose experience table prices the levels (8 is Fireball; the eight spells share one curve).

woven.label: Weaving
woven.description: Off: every slot casts its own spell alone and no partner is cast.

woven_cooldown_seconds.label: Weave Cooldown
woven_cooldown_seconds.description: How often one victim can receive the partner from the same base, in seconds.

shot_delay.label: Partner Delay
shot_delay.description: Seconds between the base's hit and the partner's cast on that victim (Fable 3's default is 1).

shot_delay_vortex.label: Partner Delay (Vortex)
shot_delay_vortex.description: The same for a vortex base.

weave_damage.label: Partner Damage
weave_damage.description: The share of their damage the partner's hits land at (Fable 3's is 0.7).
